host_activity_gate.cpu_busy_if: a non-runner PID reaches 100% of one core, aggregate non-runner CPU reaches one core, or 1-minute load reaches 28
host_activity_gate.cpu_sample: /proc/stat and per-PID /proc/<pid>/stat utime+stime deltas; requested 0.25 seconds, actual interval recorded
host_activity_gate.gpu_busy_if: GPU identity or C/G process set differs from pinned baseline, utilization exceeds 10%, device memory exceeds 925 MiB, any per-process framebuffer memory exceeds baseline by 64 MiB, or total exceeds 874 MiB
host_activity_gate.gpu_process_source: nvidia-smi pmon -c 1 -s um; includes C, G, and C+G clients
host_activity_gate.limitation: point-in-time snapshots cannot rule out brief activity between polls; a changed desktop session requires a newly reviewed protocol
host_activity_gate.unknown_policy: fail closed if CPU or GPU activity cannot be sampled

backend_threading_policy.declared_policy: retain pinned library defaults; verify worker threadpool configuration including 28-thread OpenMP/BLAS defaults; record Maestro backend/shot-dependent threading; no cap tuning
S84 treatment: OMP and OpenBLAS limited to one before native imports
